decisions.quote: This study aimed to replicate research behind Climate Schools: Alcohol and Cannabis course among a large cohort of adolescents. METHODS: Seventy-one secondary schools across three States participated in a cluster-randomised controlled trial. Year 8 students received either the web-based Climate Schools: Alcohol and Cannabis course (Climate, n = 3236), or health education as usual (Control, n = 3150).
decisions.reason: The supplied source text (7252b65650fbd13d.txt) contains only the title, author list, abstract, and publisher reference list, with the note 'Publisher reference list (article body unavailable)' at line 6 (and no prior adjudication file existed). Although the abstract states that 'This study aimed to replicate research behind Climate Schools: Alcohol and Cannabis course among a large cohort of adolescents' and 'replicate alcohol effects in a large and diverse sample of students', it provides no in-text citations, while the reference list contains multiple distinct primary trials of the Climate Schools program by the same research group—including Newton et al. (2009) (10.1080/00048670802653364, Alcohol module, already present as shipped row 258), Newton et al. (2010) (10.1111/j.1360-0443.2009.02853.x, final results of the combined Alcohol and Cannabis course), Champion et al. (2015) (10.1177/0004867415577435, cross-validation trial of the internet-based alcohol and cannabis program), Teesson et al. (2017) (10.1017/S0033291717000198), and Newton et al. (2018) (10.1186/s13011-018-0171-4). Without the article body, the available evidence cannot establish which specific original work(s) were empirically retested as replication targets or whether any target beyond shipped row 258 was omitted.
